children: Egypt's QORE has started construction on its first real estate project, the 4 billion Egyptian pound ($77.09 million) Maydan mixed-use project in 6th of October City, the company said on Sunday.
The project is being developed on a land plot of approximately 10,000 square metres (sqm), with a total built-up area of around 30,000 sqm, it said in a press statement.
CEO Medhat Sayed Abdel Hafiz said the company is deploying more than three decades of experience in construction, infrastructure and manufacturing into real estate development.
Maydan will comprise commercial, office and medical units, with completion and delivery targeted within three-and-a-half years.

QORE has appointed Inversion, Hafez Consultants and TSM Asset Management to support Maydan's investment and development strategy, engineering consultancy and design, asset management, operations, commercial activities and retail strategy.

According to the statement, QORE’s EGP30 billion ($574.2 million) investment plan through 2030 will target a diversified real estate portfolio, with a particular focus on 6th of October City. Additional investment opportunities being evaluated in 6th of October City include a 20-feddan Al-Thawra land plot and less than 20-feddan Boulevard land plot.
(Writing by Marwa Abo Almajd; Editing by Anoop Menon)
